grasses and non-seeded annual forbs responded positively to gypsum amendment within the first 14 months after application in 1988 (see Table 3), although gypsum responses were confounded somewhat by a two-way interaction with Nfertilization. More clearly positive effects of gypsum on herbaceous species productivity emerged in 1989 and 1990. This may have been due to the passage of additional time for fuller expression of gypsum's ameliorative effects on spoil sodicity.
